decisions.reason: GA4 remains the relevant analytics standard for online shops in 2025, so the plugin still fits the firm's implementation and support business despite some risk from platform changes and standardization.
A dedicated Universal Analytics plugin has effectively lost its market after Google's shutdown, so keeping it would tie up resources with little customer value.
SEO support for shop relaunches is closely tied to the firm's relaunch, marketing, and conversion services and should remain a useful, sale-oriented offering.

SEO workshops complement the firm's consulting expertise and can generate leads and client trust, though they are somewhat easier to discontinue than core implementation services if demand is limited.
